# Deep Research

Deep Research investigates complex questions and produces comprehensive, source-backed
documents, PDFs, presentations, spreadsheets, and Sites. It starts with supplied sources,
follows evidence gaps, and cites claims in the format suited to the artifact. A document or
presentation with a newly built chart includes a spreadsheet of the supporting data.

Ask for deep research in your own words, use `$deep-research`, or select Deep Research in Work mode. An ordinary research request does not start this comprehensive artifact workflow.

Use it to explore unfamiliar topics, compare options, reconcile conflicting evidence,
and support consequential decisions with current, authoritative sources. The chosen
artifact is tailored to the audience and decision.
